verdicts.reason: A is just the original scaled down and centred, with wide blank white bars on both sides. That wastes about half the banner and leaves the date line and 'DDG Studio Presents' small, but the card, hierarchy and brand all survive intact. B is broken: the white card juts off the left edge of the patterned art, and 'The Minimalist' pill has come loose and sits awkwardly beside the date. The white frame and both pink dots have drifted to the right, away from the name, so one dot floats on the pattern and the other in an empty white frame. The art no longer reaches the canvas edges, which reads as fragmented and unintentional.
